scope: 28 finished cases only; trial-01 and trial-06 execution failures excluded. Saved request, original remark and retrieved passage evidence reviewed; full filings were not exhaustively adjudicated. No inference rerun.

rows.reason: Broad claim of competitive positioning supported only by examples of project types; no bounded factual request selected.

Tariffs and transition to low-GWP products are named mechanisms for potential project delays. A specific qualitative risk is not automatically too general. No evidence retrieval was performed, so no positive match is established.
Cited passage reports 83 million / 9% Software and Services NET SALES growth, not 732 million BACKLOG growth. Contract and UK Home Office explanations are not established.

Cited clinical tables support some anticipated decisions, not all required approvals. Odronextamab late-line follicular-lymphoma US approval is not established by the cited passages. Approval in another jurisdiction is insufficient.

Two 500 million notes at 4.650% and 5.100% total 1 billion and give a principal-weighted coupon of 4.875%, rounded to 4.88%. Proceeds redeem the 2025 notes. Corporate wind-down assertion is outside the narrower request.
Administrative call agenda; exclusion is appropriate even though too_general is an approximate schema label.

Cited passage concerns index/workflow revenues, not consolidated 12.5% net-revenue growth. Uncited candidate rank 5 reports revenues less transaction expenses of 1237 vs 1117 million, 10.7%, not 12.5%.

Candidates do not establish orders exceeding sales excluding acquired backlog. Sales alone and remaining performance obligations are insufficient. Judge wrongly implies numerical orders are always required; the qualitative relationship would suffice if sourced.
Tariff risk is present, but cited passage 32 is ESG disclosure, not lighter FX headwinds. It does not establish the forecast that FX offsets tariff-related indirect costs in 2025.
Cited income-tax/audit and EPS discussion does not state non-GAAP tax rate 13.8%. No sourced non-GAAP reconciliation establishing it was identified in retrieved candidates.

Table supports EC approval of Lynozyfic for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma under 2025 Events to Date. It does not date it to Q1, which the generated request added. Hold current request; propose removing invented Q1 timing, not declaring it correct as written.
Passage explicitly states January 2025 quarterly dividend increase of 0.0575 per share, 6.9%, effective with March payment.
Cited passage covers property inventory, leases and distributions, not rent recapture 103.9%, 194 leases or 92% renewals.
Administrative participant introduction, not personal opinion. Exclusion correct; reason label imprecise.

Passage reports gross margin 52.8% vs 50.5%, a 230-bp change, not 140 bps. It does not supply the requested 130-bp operating-margin increase. Do not substitute GAAP results for potentially adjusted remark figures.

Retrieved litigation, FDA compliance and buyback passages do not support chartered direct flights or freight-cost comparison. This is candidate insufficiency, not proof the full filing lacks evidence.
Request changes full-year tariff estimate into Q1. Cited passage reports operating results and does not establish 400 million / 0.60 EPS tariff impact.

Passage discusses reported R&D down 2.5% and SG&A down 1.5%, with cost initiatives, not the requested 1% decline in NON-GAAP core operating expense. No sourced bridge establishes the adjusted measure.

Passage clearly supplies prior-year 59.3 million Takata settlement and SG&A increase of 14.1%, or 3.1% excluding it. Original remark is a fragment and does not identify the result being compared. Human must decide suitability of this standalone input; do not add surrounding transcript context.
ASR table reports 225 million and total 5,242,382 repurchased shares, matching 5.2 million at stated precision. Do not confuse initial delivery 4,353,517 with total delivered shares.

Rank 1 supplies revenue 883.9 vs 634.3 million, 39% growth, and adjusted operating income 390.7 million. Rank 2 explicitly supplies 44% adjusted operating margin. Together support current Rule-of-40 sum 83%. Do not claim they establish prior-quarter 2-point change or seventh consecutive increase.
Broad statement about resilience and portfolio diversification without a bounded factual target.
Request incorrectly converts full-year outlook into fiscal-Q1 outlook. Cited passage describes accounting policies, not 20–21% adjusted EBITDA guidance or 13.75–14.75 non-GAAP EPS.

Candidates do not supply all four guidance items. Request incorrectly substitutes Q1 for original full-year horizon; rejection is appropriate for available candidates but not evidence that the original full-year claim is wrong.

Cited EPS and other-income table supports diluted EPS 2.53 vs NEGATIVE 0.23, and 585 million prior-year Silver Lake extinguishment loss. Original transcript omits the negative sign. Valid request evidence; original remark requires explicitly recorded sign correction.
Cited credit-covenant passage mentions a maximum leverage ratio, not actual gross leverage of 3.4x at quarter-end. Compliance does not establish the requested ratio.

Filing identifies MISSION Systems, not admission systems, and a 4% decline in OPERATING INCOME, not margin. Margin fell from 14.2% to 12.9% (130 bps). Related drivers match, but current request conflates measures and cannot be accepted unchanged.

Cited EBIT decline of 15% and gross-margin expansion of 180 bps refer to NORTH AMERICA. Another candidate also reports 15% EBIT decline for another region. Original standalone remark and generated request omit region. Judge also fabricates 120 bps. Do not assign company-wide or infer omitted region from surrounding discussion.
